clinical_features.symptoms:
signs 
• 
General examination & any evidence underlying diseases 
• 
Neurological examination 
• 
Signs of meningitis 
• 
Focal neurological deficit 
 
Investigations 
• 
ECG, blood glucose and blood gas on ALL patients 
• 
Urine-HCG on ALL female patients 
• 
Tailor further investigations to clinical findings 
• 
Urgent CT brain with contrast if: 
• 
No return to baseline 
• 
Focal neurological deficit 
Identify and treat the precipitating factor 
Disposition 
• 
Consult Neurology/IM as appropriate 
DEFINITIONS 
Status Epilepticus 
Continuous seizures for 5 minutes or  2 discrete seizures in close 
succession without full recovery of consciousness between episodes 
Refractory Status Epilepticus 
Seizures persisting despite  2 anticonvulsant agents (i.e. 
1st & 2nd line anticonvulsants)
